Legal & Transparency

Privacy Policy

Last Updated: October 2026. How WEBSOL Digital Solutions respects and safeguards your personal data.

Home / Privacy Policy

Welcome to WEBSOL Digital Solutions ("we," "our," or "us"). We are committed to respecting and protecting the privacy of our website visitors, clients, and prospective customers. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how it is used, and the steps we take to protect your data.

1. Information We Collect

We collect personal information that you voluntarily provide to us when using our website, submitting an inquiry, or configuring project parameters through our Website Cost Calculator Tool. This may include:

  • Contact Details: Full name, email address, phone number, and company name.
  • Project Information: Website specifications, estimated budget ranges, feature selections, and project timeline requirements.
  • Technical & Analytical Data: IP address, browser type, device identifiers, referring URLs, and website usage statistics collected via anonymous analytics cookies.

2. How We Use Your Information

The information we collect is strictly used for legitimate business and client service purposes, including:

  • Preparing, calculating, and transmitting tailored project estimates and formal proposals.
  • Communicating with you regarding your inquiries, scheduled calls, or ongoing development deliverables.
  • Improving our website performance, user experience, and technical infrastructure.
  • Sending relevant service updates or educational blog newsletters (only if you have opted in).

3. Data Protection & Security

We enforce industry-standard security protocols, including 256-bit SSL encryption across our entire website, secure database architecture, and strict access limitations to safeguard your personal data from unauthorized access, disclosure, or alteration.

4. Third-Party Services & Analytics

We may use trusted third-party services (such as Google Analytics 4 and secure email delivery providers) to help analyze web traffic and deliver communications. These third parties are bound by strict confidentiality and data protection obligations. We never sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties for marketing purposes.

5. Cookies Policy

Our website uses basic session cookies to ensure interactive features (such as the Cost Calculator and navigation drawers) function properly. You can adjust your browser settings to decline cookies if you prefer, though some interactive elements may have reduced functionality.

6. Your Data Rights

Under New Zealand privacy laws and international regulations (including GDPR where applicable), you have the right to request access to the personal data we hold about you, request corrections, or request deletion of your information. To exercise these rights, please contact us at info@websol.nz.

7. Contact Us

If you have any questions or concerns regarding this Privacy Policy, please reach out to our privacy officer at:
